items.title: Energy Secretary Builds on Progress to Strengthen Puerto Rico’s Energy Reliability
items.summary: As Puerto Rico faces rising electricity demand and energy reliability challenges, the Energy Department continues its efforts to strengthen the island’s electric grid.

items.title: Calogena awarded EU funding for SMR deployment
items.summary: French small modular reactor developer Calogena has been awarded EUR40 million (USD44.6 million) through the European Commission's Innovation Fund to support the potential construction of its first commercial nuclear reactor in Pierrelatte, in southern France.

items.title: NERC Reports Progress in Cold Weather Preparedness, Launches Resource Page
items.summary: New reports from NERC and the ERO Enterprise highlight measurable improvements in the electric industry’s cold weather preparedness, while underscoring the need for continued vigilance to address winter reliability risks.

items.title: PEJ applies for early works permit for nuclear power plant
items.summary: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe has applied to the head of the Pomeranian Voivodeship for a permit to start early works required for the construction of Poland's first nuclear power plant at the Lubiatowo-Kopalino site in the Choczewo municipality.

items.title: First concrete poured for unit 5 at Haiyang plant
items.summary: The first safety-related concrete has been poured for the reactor building of unit 5 at the Haiyang nuclear power plant. It is the fifth of six large pressurised water reactors planned for the site in China's Shandong province.

items.title: Texas SMR plant moves to final permitting stage
items.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission says there will soon be a construction permit announcement after it finished its safety review for the Xe-100 reactor, which is proposed for deployment at the Long Mott Generating Station in Texas.

items.title: Next-generation fuel projects get US federal funding
items.summary: Eight nuclear fuel technology projects have been selected to receive a share of up to USD50 million of federal funding under a US Department of Energy programme to support R&D to deliver TRU fuel technologies.

items.title: The share of solar generation with co-located battery storage is increasing
items.summary: Utility-scale solar developers are increasingly co-locating battery storage with new solar photovoltaic capacity. As of September 2026, over 16% of new utility-scale solar capacity added this year is co-located with operable battery storage, compared with 2% in 2017, according…

items.title: Cernavoda units remain shut down due to Danube water levels
items.summary: Romania's Nuclearelectrica says that although there has been a recent rise in the local water level in the River Danube, current forecasts do not yet support a decision to restart the units.

items.title: US government loan to support Constellation uprates
items.summary: US utility Constellation has secured a conditional loan commitment of up to USD5 billion from the Department of Energy's Office of Energy Dominance Financing towards uprates and modernisation projects across its nuclear power reactor fleet in Illinois, Maryland, and Pennsylvania.

items.title: Energy Department Closes $5.1 Billion Loan to Lower Electricity Costs and Strengthen Grid Reliability in Iowa and Wisconsin
items.summary: The U.S. Department of Energy’s Office of Energy Dominance Financing today announced the financial close of a $5.1 billion loan package to Alliant Energy to lower electricity costs, expand firm power generation, and strengthen grid reliability in Iowa and Wisconsin.

items.title: Energy Department Announces $5 Billion Loan to Boost Nuclear Power and Help Lower Costs in Illinois, Maryland, and Pennsylvania
items.summary: The U.S. Department of Energy’s Office of Energy Dominance Financing today announced a conditional loan commitment of up to $5 billion to finance nuclear uprates and modernization across Constellation Energy’s nuclear fleet in Illinois, Maryland, and Pennsylvania.

items.title: Korea's Kori 3 and 4 set for restarts in 2027
items.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has been given approval by South Korea's Nuclear Safety and Security Commission to continue operating Kori Nuclear Power Plant’s unit 3 and 4 for a further 10 years.
